G3_faithfulness.justification: For values in {1,2}, requiring each constrained pair to have product 2 is equivalent to requiring the two workers to receive different shifts, though the rewrite explicitly permits self-pairs while the original does not clearly specify whether they are allowed.

G4_naturalness.justification: The scenario is coherent and readable, although the gear-ratio framing and repeated-component clarification feel somewhat artificial for this simple graph-coloring task.
